Front seats: - Front seats can be adjusted manually or electrically depending on the version.
- Ensure proper posture with your back resting fully on the seat backrest.
- Seat height, length, backrest angle and lumbar support are adjustable.
- Heated and ventilated seat functions are available in some models.
- Move the seat with caution to avoid pinching injuries.
- Memory function may store seat positions for multiple users.
Rear seats: - Rear seatbacks can be folded down to increase luggage space.
- Make sure seat belts are not caught when folding.
- Some versions include heating for the rear seats.
- ISOFIX and Top Tether anchors are integrated into outer rear seats.
- Always return seatbacks to locked position after folding.
- Do not allow passengers to sit on folded seatbacks.
Headrest: - Adjust headrest so the top aligns with the top of your head.
- Move headrest forward or backward to match head position.
- Do not remove headrest unless absolutely necessary.
- Ensure it clicks into place after adjustment.
Seat functions: - Some seats feature massage, ventilation, and memory settings.
- Seat heating can be activated via climate control or infotainment system.
- Settings may be stored per user profile.
- Do not use seat heating with wet clothes or objects.
- Avoid obstructing ventilation outlets on ventilated seats.
